sources.official_body: General Administration of Customs of the PRC (海关总署), Statistics & Analysis Dept.
sources.access_method: HTML web query form with partial table download. No documented public API. A headless browser can call the backend XHR after the slider or captcha step. It could not be reached from this sandbox: the DNS lookup failed because the session's network policy blocks the host.
endpoints: http://stats.customs.gov.cn/  (VERIFIED as the official address; also reachable via www.customs.gov.cn > 政务公开 > 数说海关 > 数据在线查询)

http://stats.customs.gov.cn/queryData/queryDataByWhere  (POST form-encoded; REMEMBERED, UNVERIFIED) params: pageSize=10000, iEType=0 (export) | 1 (import), currencyType=usd | rmb, year=2026, startMonth=1, endMonth=9, monthFlag=1 (one row per month; blank = cumulative), unitFlag=true (include quantities), codeLength=8, outerField1=CODE_TS, outerField2=ORIGIN_COUNTRY (partner), outerField3=TRADE_MODE, outerField4=TRADE_CO_PORT (consignor registered province/city), outerValue1=04090000, outerValue2..4= (blank = all), orderType=CODE ASC DEFAULT
http://stats.customs.gov.cn/indexEn  (English UI; REMEMBERED)
sources.auth: None. A slider or captcha verification on the query form is remembered, not verified.
sources.cost_licensing: Free. Chinese government website with no published API or licence terms. High-frequency automated access is likely to be throttled. Attribute to 'GACC'.
sources.update_frequency: Monthly. Single-month and year-to-date views, with history back to about 2015 (remembered).
sources.publication_lag: Detailed HS8 × partner data appear about 3 weeks after month end, around the 20th of M+1 (remembered).
sources.data_available: CN statistical code 04090000 天然蜂蜜 (10-digit tariff line 0409000000, MFN 15%: verified via tariff listings). Selectable dimensions (verified via third-party guides): commodity (HS8), trading partner, trade mode (一般贸易 general trade vs 进料加工 processing), and consignor registered location (province). Measures: 第一数量 (kg), 第二数量, and value in USD or RMB yuan. Exports are FOB and imports CIF (standard GACC practice). Imports into China (e.g., NZ manuka, Kyrgyz and Russian honey) are also available.
sources.value_for_parodi: China is the world's largest honey exporter. This source gives monthly export tonnage and USD value by destination (UK, Belgium, Poland, Spain, Netherlands, Japan, Italy...), from which China FOB USD/kg per destination can be computed. It arrives months ahead of Comtrade. The province and trade-mode splits (e.g., Anhui, Hubei, Jiangxi, Henan exporters; general vs processing trade) do not exist in Comtrade or Eurostat mirrors.
sources.parsing_notes: Partner codes are China customs 3-digit codes (REMEMBERED, verify): 116 Japan, 301 Belgium, 303 UK, 304 Germany, 307 Italy, 309 Netherlands, 312 Spain, 502 USA. Quantity is in kg; compute value/qty for USD/kg. The response is an HTML table fragment, not JSON (remembered). The site is often slow or unstable from outside China. The most robust approach is a monthly run in the owner's Chrome (the owner offered it) or Playwright, saving the CSV/HTML into Paladex. Keep currencyType=usd to avoid FX conversion. With monthFlag=1 you get the single-month series directly instead of having to difference YTD figures.
sources.sample_response: RECONSTRUCTED (not observed): HTML <table> columns: 数据年月 | 商品编码 | 商品名称 | 贸易伙伴编码 | 贸易伙伴名称 | 贸易方式 | 注册地 | 第一数量 | 第一计量单位 | 第二数量 | 第二计量单位 | 美元 ; e.g. 202609 | 04090000 | 天然蜂蜜 | 303 | 英国 | 一般贸易 | 安徽省 | 1234567 | 千克 | 0 | - | 2345678
sources.rate_limits: Undocumented. Captcha plus likely IP throttling.

sources.publication_lag: Quick estimates come out around the 15th of M+1 (remembered). 8-digit country detail on TradeStat typically lags about 1.5–2 months; check the 'data last updated' stamp on each page.
sources.data_available: ITC-HS 04090000 'Natural honey'. Exports and imports by partner country, month and cumulative Indian FY (April–March). Value in US$ million or ₹ crore. Quantity in UQC KGS (the display may be in thousands, so verify). The monthly system also offers per-unit price in ₹ and US$.
sources.value_for_parodi: Gives India's monthly export volume and FOB unit value by destination; the USA takes about 80% (2019 coverage), the rest goes to Gulf and EU markets. These can be checked directly against the US$1,400/t MEP floor. India's Comtrade reporting is usually many months late, so this is much fresher.
sources.parsing_notes: Values come in US$ million to 2 decimals, which is too coarse for small partners. Request the per-unit US$ or ₹ option, or use ₹ values and convert. FY boundary is April. Country names are text, so map them to ISO. Fallback mirror (third party, ISB India Data Portal): monthly 8-digit dataset, quantity in thousands, value in US$ million.

sources.name: DGFT Notifications – Minimum Export Price (MEP) on Natural Honey
sources.official_body: Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry
sources.access_method: HTML notification list with PDF gazette notifications. Monitor by scraping the list page.
endpoints: https://www.dgft.gov.in/CP/?opt=notification  (REMEMBERED list URL; official dgft.gov.in not fetched)
sources.update_frequency: Ad hoc. Past extensions came at quarter or year end.
sources.data_available: ITC-HS 04090000. Notification No. 09/2026-27 dated 10 Apr 2026 extends the MEP of US$1,400/MT FOB to 31 Dec 2026. Earlier steps: No. 52/2025-26 (31 Dec 2025) extended it to 31 Mar 2026. In August 2025 the MEP was cut from US$2,000 to US$1,400/MT. The MEP was first introduced in March 2024 at US$2,000/MT; Notif. 45/2024-25 is cited with the US$2,000 floor. Export policy stays 'Free' subject to the MEP. All of these come from secondary legal-news sources; verify on dgft.gov.in.
sources.value_for_parodi: This is a legal floor price for Indian honey offers (US$1.40/kg FOB), so it directly sets the bottom of Indian quotes. It expires 31 Dec 2026, about 8 weeks from today. Paladex should alert on renewal, change or lapse.
sources.parsing_notes: Match notification titles containing 'honey' / '04090000' / 'Minimum Export Price'. Store the MEP value, currency, Incoterm (FOB) and validity end date as a time series.

https://api.e-stat.go.jp/rest/3.0/app/getSimpleStatsData?appId={APPID}&statsDataId=0003425294&cdCat01=040900000&sectionHeaderFlg=2  (CSV)
https://www.e-stat.go.jp/dbview?sid=0003425294  (browser view)

Table IDs (VERIFIED via ecitizen.jp mirror): 0003425294 = 品別国別表 輸入 (imports, 2021–2024 confirmed + 2025 preliminary, ~18.9M records); 0003425293 = 品別国別表 輸出 (exports); 0003425300 = 海上コンテナ貨物品別国別表 輸入; 0003425302 = 税関別品別国別表 輸入
sources.auth: Free appId from e-Stat user registration (マイページ > API機能 > アプリケーションID発行)
sources.cost_licensing: Free. Commercial use is allowed (official FAQ). Published apps must show the e-Stat credit notice (FAQ). Terms are compatible with the Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use (CC BY 4.0-compatible; remembered).
sources.publication_lag: From MOF/Customs documents: 9-digit import preliminary (輸入9桁速報) around the end of M+1; import confirmed (確報) around the end of M+2; annual final (確定) around March of the following year. Whether table 0003425294 holds monthly or annual time codes must be checked with getMetaInfo.
sources.data_available: Japan statistical code 0409.00-000 天然はちみつ (9-digit 040900000; general tariff 30%, WTO 25.5%: verified). Imports by country of origin, with quantity (KG) and value (thousand JPY, CIF; units remembered). Exports in 0003425293. Monthly history on Japan Customs runs back to 1988 (third-party claim).
sources.value_for_parodi: Gives monthly CIF JPY/kg by origin. China supplies about 70% of Japan's imports (MAFF); Argentina, Canada, Hungary, Myanmar, NZ and others also ship. That makes it an independent official price benchmark for Chinese and Argentine bulk honey in a second major market, available a few weeks after month end and cleanly via API. Convert JPY with the ECB rates already in Paladex.
sources.parsing_notes: Always filter by item code: the tables have tens of millions of rows. Japan Customs country codes are 3-digit; 105 = China is remembered, so map the rest from getMetaInfo CLASS_OBJ. Quantity and value are separate 'tab' measure items. Table IDs are re-issued as years roll, so call getStatsList on each run. Pagination: follow RESULT_INF.NEXT_KEY with startPosition. Max 100,000 rows per call (remembered from the spec).

recommendation:
Build in this order, ranked by value to a bulk-honey buyer and by how hard each is to automate.

1. **Japan e-Stat API.** Build this first: it is the region's only official REST API. The appId is free and commercial use is allowed if the e-Stat credit notice is shown. Resolve the table ID on each run with getStatsList (statsCode=00350300), confirm the dimension IDs once with getMetaInfo, then pull 9-digit code 040900000 imports by country. That gives monthly CIF JPY/kg for Chinese, Argentine, Canadian, Hungarian and Myanmar honey. Convert with the ECB rates Paladex already has.

2. **India TradeStat monthly.** Scrape the HTML for HS 04090000, exports, 'Commodity-wise all Countries', with quantity plus US$ per unit (or ₹). Compare unit values with the DGFT minimum export price.

3. **DGFT notifications watcher.** Add this now. Indian honey's minimum export price is US$1,400/t FOB under Notification 09/2026-27 and expires 31 Dec 2026, about 8 weeks away. Alert on renewal, change or lapse.

4. **China GACC query platform.** This is the most valuable dataset in the region: China's monthly FOB USD/kg by destination, plus trade-mode and exporter-province splits that Comtrade lacks. It has no public API, a captcha and an unstable connection from abroad. The practical design is a monthly semi-automated pull: Playwright, or the owner's own Chrome, which they offered. Query exports, usd, codeLength=8, outerValue1=04090000, grouped by partner, trade mode and province with monthFlag=1, and import the table into Paladex.

5. **Turkey.** Pull the TÜİK foreign-trade database monthly (HS6 040900 by country, USD and kg; also a stateful UI, so use a browser). Add the TÜİK animal-production bulletin each February (2025: 97,253 t honey). Watch the Ministry of Agriculture's adulterated-food list for 'bal' entries, which gives supplier red flags.

6. **Supplier-compliance layer.** Add the EIC list of approved Indian honey establishments for EU export, and APEDA AgriExchange as an annual cross-check. Use the /indexp/ pages: the /IntTrade/ page shows world imports, not India's exports.

7. **Vietnam.** Vietnam's customs service publishes no free honey line, so rely on the US Census (GATS) and Comext mirror data already integrated. Keep Vietnamese government and VCCI pages only as news signals on the US anti-dumping duty.

8. **Optional context.** China's statistics bureau annual honey output (easyquery JSON) and the Japanese agriculture ministry's beekeeping PDFs.

**What is verified and what is not:**
- **Verified through search results:** platform URLs and their query dimensions; the e-Stat table IDs 0003425294 (imports) and 0003425293 (exports); the honey codes (CN 04090000 / 0409000000, ITC-HS 04090000, Japan 040900000) and Japan's 25.5% WTO tariff; the DGFT price-floor history; the TÜİK 2025 production figures; the Japanese release calendar; the EIC and Japanese agriculture-ministry documents.
- **Remembered and must be verified:** the GACC backend endpoint and its parameter names, the TradeStat monthly route and form field names, the TÜİK trade-database URLs and Turkey's 12-digit honey codes, e-Stat dimension IDs and country codes, and DGCI&S portal pricing.

**Blockers:**
- WebFetch could not open any official site. stats.customs.gov.cn, www.e-stat.go.jp and s.apifox.cn failed DNS resolution, and the agent proxy refuses tunnels to most government hosts. Live checks need these hosts allowed in the session's network settings: stats.customs.gov.cn, api.e-stat.go.jp, www.e-stat.go.jp, tradestat.commerce.gov.in, agriexchange.apeda.gov.in, dgft.gov.in, eicindia.gov.in, biruni.tuik.gov.tr, data.tuik.gov.tr, veriportali.tuik.gov.tr, customs.gov.vn and data.stats.gov.cn. The alternative is to run those checks in the owner's Chrome.
- The shared WebSearch budget (200 calls per turn) ran out before Turkey's trade database, Vietnam's customs data and China's statistics-bureau indicator codes could be confirmed. A follow-up turn can finish those checks.
